authority: Arthur's explicit Phase 5 delegation; parent steer authorizes read-only boot plus written exact plan as planning stage in Default mode. Sole executor; no remaining subagents.
format: audio/wav; canonical 44-byte RIFF PCM header; mono signed 16-bit; browser 16000 Hz
identityEvidence: Fixed model in a single request to the official endpoint; no fallback or retry. A returned model/header, when supplied, must match. Documented transcription JSON does not guarantee a model echo; absent echoes are reported as null, never fabricated.
accountAccess: Not tested by paid calls. Missing key or inaccessible model fails recoverably.
tokenBudget: Duration-priced transcription; no undocumented max-token request parameter. UTF-8 response/transcript byte and character bounds enforced before insertion.
noRetention: No audio on filesystem, storage, chat, project, recovery, analytics, logs, proof, or object URLs. Mutable buffers are cleared; immutable request blobs and device resources are dereferenced on terminal paths. No physical RAM-erasure claim.
providerRetention: Official endpoint table lists no training, no abuse-monitoring retention, no application-state retention for audio/transcriptions; no unsupported store field sent.
capBehavior: Either cap stops and discards the capture with a recoverable message. Caps never trigger upload.
insertion: Append to the latest current composer draft, preserving typed edits. Refuse whole insertion if the 12000-character composer ceiling would be exceeded. Never Send automatically.
reviewUse: Arthur may explicitly record and Stop in the private review app using its already configured server-only credential.
